features.name: log_capital_total_norm
features.description: Bounded log transform of total capital-run length, normalized by the training-fold maximum to reduce heavy-tail dominance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses a heavy-tailed size measure into a bounded coordinate, reducing dominance of very long messages in Euclidean neighborhoods.

features.name: capital_burst_ratio
features.description: Ratio of the longest capital run to total capital-run length, clipped to a bounded interval.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates concentrated capital bursts from broadly capitalized text while remaining bounded for distance metrics.

features.name: emphasis_punctuation_norm
features.description: Average of log-normalized high-emphasis punctuation frequencies from char_freq_3, char_freq_4, and char_freq_5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a bounded emphasis-punctuation coordinate so rows with similar punctuation intensity are nearby.
features.formula: np.clip((np.log1p(char_freq_3) / np.log1p(32.478) + np.log1p(char_freq_4) / np.log1p(5.3) + np.log1p(char_freq_5) / np.log1p(13.129)) / 3.0, 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: structural_punctuation_norm
features.description: Average of log-normalized structural punctuation frequencies from char_freq_0, char_freq_1, and char_freq_2.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-emphasis structural punctuation similarity, adding geometry not redundant with word-frequency axes.
features.formula: np.clip((np.log1p(char_freq_0) / np.log1p(4.123) + np.log1p(char_freq_1) / np.log1p(9.752) + np.log1p(char_freq_2) / np.log1p(4.081)) / 3.0, 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: commercial_offer_word_norm
features.description: Log-normalized aggregate of word-frequency fields associated with commercial, action-oriented, or transactional wording.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups commercial-offer wording into one smooth axis, reducing sparse-token mismatch for nearest-neighbor search.
features.formula: np.clip(np.log1p(word_freq_7 + word_freq_8 + word_freq_9 + word_freq_10 + word_freq_15 + word_freq_16 + word_freq_17 + word_freq_19 + word_freq_22 + word_freq_23) / np.log1p(54.91), 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: direct_address_word_norm
features.description: Log-normalized aggregate of word-frequency fields that reflect direct addressing and conversational wording.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups direct-address and conversational wording into a scale-normalized coordinate for local similarity.
features.formula: np.clip(np.log1p(word_freq_4 + word_freq_11 + word_freq_12 + word_freq_18 + word_freq_20) / np.log1p(44.24), 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: institutional_technical_word_norm
features.description: Log-normalized aggregate of word-frequency fields associated with institutional, technical, project, or meeting-style communication.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a counterbalancing technical or institutional style coordinate, improving separation of different writing regimes in neighbor space.
features.formula: np.clip(np.log1p(word_freq_24 + word_freq_25 + word_freq_26 + word_freq_28 + word_freq_29 + word_freq_32 + word_freq_35 + word_freq_41 + word_freq_43 + word_freq_45 + word_freq_47) / np.log1p(143.03), 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: active_word_fraction
features.description: Fraction of the 48 word-frequency fields with nonzero frequency in the row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures vocabulary breadth as a density coordinate, helping KNN distinguish sparse from content-rich messages.

features.name: unsupervised_core_center_distance
features.description: Euclidean distance from an unsupervised training-fold center on selected high-variance word, punctuation, and capital-run coordinates, using training-fold standard deviations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a radial distance from an unsupervised training-fold center, helping local neighborhoods reflect atypical multi-axis profiles.

features.name: quiet_sparse_profile_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for rows with very low activity on core word, punctuation, and capital-run axes, using unsupervised training-fold thresholds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives KNN a crisp low-activity region marker so quiet short rows can share neighbors even when individual raw fields differ.
features.formula: np.where(((word_freq_18 + word_freq_20 + word_freq_11 + word_freq_24 + word_freq_25 + word_freq_26 + char_freq_3 + char_freq_4 + char_freq_5) < 0.25) & (capital_run_length_total < 40.0) & (capital_run_length_longest < 10.0), 1.0, 0.0)

features.name: semantic_promotional_intensity_score
features.description: Numeric judgment from 0.0 to 5.0 estimating how strongly the row reads like a promotional or transactional message, considering word-frequency patterns, emphasis punctuation, currency-like punctuation, and capital-run behavior.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a soft semantic axis for promotional intensity so similar messages can be closer even with different exact token fields.

features.name: semantic_institutional_tone_score
features.description: Numeric judgment from 0.0 to 5.0 estimating technical, organizational, or academic communication tone from the row's word-frequency profile and relatively restrained punctuation or capitalization.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a high-level style axis that can place technical or organizational messages closer in neighbor space.
